name: Bronte Davies
bio:
Bronte's journey into motorsport was somewhat unconventional. After a decade in corporate supply chain management, she volunteered at a local karting event and was immediately hooked by the organized chaos. Her corporate background provided a strong foundation in logistics, but she quickly adapted to the unique demands of racing, managing everything from spare parts inventories to coordinating travel for the entire team. 

At Birel ART Factory, Bronte thrives on the fast-paced environment. She's known for her meticulous planning and ability to anticipate potential problems before they arise, ensuring that the team has everything they need to perform at their best, whether they're racing in Europe or further afield. Her ability to see the big picture while still attending to the smallest details makes her an invaluable asset to the team. 

What sets Bronte apart is her calm demeanor under pressure. While others might panic when facing unexpected delays or logistical nightmares, she remains cool and collected, finding creative solutions to keep the team on track. Her unflappable attitude and proactive approach have earned her the respect and trust of everyone at Birel ART.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy hair, often tied back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Bronte is a woman of average height with a kind face and a practical demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with logistical diagrams and contingency plans.
Has a habit of color-coding everything in her workspace.
Starts every day with a strong cup of tea, regardless of where in the world she is.
